Run Projection Scenario 1 + 2 + 3 (Supply-Constrained Mixed Input-Output Model)

run_projection_scenario.Rd

Accepts any free combination of BAU scenario, Assumption 1, Assumption 2, and Assumption 3. All scenario parameters are optional. The function will automatically enable the appropriate logic based on which parameters are not NULL.

Usage

run_projection_scenario(
  gdp_baseline,
  income_multiplier,
  labour_multiplier,
  SUB_multiplier,
  output_multiplier,
  linkage_table,
  leontief_matrix,
  full_io_table,
  sector_idx,
  P_baseline,
  area_matrix_bau,
  growth_rate,
  constrained = NULL,
  unconstrained = NULL,
  P_scenario = NULL,
  area_matrix_scenario = NULL,
  lpc_scenario = NULL,
  lpc_target_year = NULL,
  io_changes = NULL,
  growth_rate_scenario = NULL,
  pop_projection = NULL
)

Arguments

gdp_baseline

Data frame. Baseline GDP table.

income_multiplier, labour_multiplier, SUB_multiplier, output_multiplier, linkage_table

Data frame. Baseline multiplier & linkage tables.

leontief_matrix

Numeric matrix. Baseline Leontief inverse (unused).

full_io_table

Numeric matrix. Complete Z matrix.

sector_idx

Integer vector. Sector indices in the full IO table.

P_baseline

Numeric matrix. Baseline land proportion [n_sector x n_cover].

area_matrix_bau

Numeric matrix. BAU land area [n_cover x n_year].

growth_rate

Numeric vector. Baseline final demand growth rate.

constrained, unconstrained

Integer vector. Co/nc indicator flags.

P_scenario

Numeric matrix or NULL. Scenario land proportion (Assumption 1).

area_matrix_scenario

Numeric matrix or NULL. Scenario land area (Assumption 1).

lpc_scenario

Data frame or NULL. New LPC targets (Assumption 2).

lpc_target_year

Integer or NULL. LPC target year (Assumption 2). Default: last year.

io_changes

Data frame or NULL. Scenario ΔZ & ΔX (Assumption 3).

growth_rate_scenario

Numeric vector or NULL. Growth rate override.

pop_projection

Data frame atau NULL. Proyeksi penduduk dengan kolom `Tahun` dan `Populasi`. Jika NULL, kolom Pendapatan/PDRB per Kapita akan bernilai NA. (Opsional)

Value

Tibble of projection results per (year x sector) with columns: YEAR, SECTOR, LAND_REQUIREMENT, LPC, LPC_GROWTH_RATE, FD, OUTPUT, GDP, INCOME, LABOUR, SURPLUS, ITBL, ITFL (end/active condition values). Diagnostic attributes, including `linkage_compare`: a data frame per sector containing SECTOR, ITBL_BEFORE, ITBL_AFTER, DELTA_ITBL, ITFL_BEFORE, ITFL_AFTER, DELTA_ITFL. Without Assumption 3, BEFORE values equal AFTER values.

Details

Supported combinations:

  1. BAU only (area_bau, lpc=NULL, io=NULL)

  2. BAU + A1 (area_sc, lpc=NULL, io=NULL)

  3. BAU + A1 + A2 (area_sc, lpc=..., io=NULL)

  4. BAU + A1 + A3 (area_sc, lpc=NULL, io=...)

  5. BAU + A2 (area_bau, lpc=..., io=NULL)

  6. BAU + A2 + A3 (area_bau, lpc=..., io=...)

  7. BAU + A3 (area_bau, lpc=NULL, io=...)
